description: Permanently delete Ravenpost’s copy of a post and cancel any scheduled publish — the post cannot be restored. Use this to remove drafts or duplicate/obsolete scheduled posts. It never takes a post down from a network: a post already published stays live on the platform. The dashboard offers a separate "delete everywhere" on the networks Ravenpost can delete from (a post on Instagram, TikTok, Threads and YouTube cannot be taken down through Ravenpost at all); this tool does not.
name: delete_post
title: Delete a post
